items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: And that included the three of us with Lee Collins and I brought a piano player with me. I hope his name would come to me. Walt.

ctx.x: Pete Herman was my sister and they were clubs were one block apart. So Lee Collins heard about me and sent for me to go to work with them in LaSalle, Illinois, as a teeniest silver Congo. We followed Ethel Waters in there. Now, the funny thing about that, we worked in LaSalle, but we had to live three cities away. Spring Valley we lived in. There was a town in between they called Piru, Illinois. There were no blacks living in those Piru, no LaSalle. And in Spring Valley, there was a total of 23 blacks living in…
This is Real number 3 and we're still with Percy Gabriel on July 10th, 1987. We were talking about fish fries.
